parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup plan. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html to query the backup plan ID
parameters.help_zh: 备份计划ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: backup_plan_id

parameters.help_en:
The location of the database. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html to query this value. Valid values:

- **RDS**

- **ECS**

- **Express**: A database connected through a leased line, VPN Gateway, or Smart Gateway.

- **Agent**: A database connected through a backup gateway.

- **DDS**: Cloud MongoDB.

- **Other**: A database directly connected through IP:Port
parameters.help_zh:
数据库所在位置，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。取值如下：

- **RDS**
- **ECS**
- **Express**：通过专线/VPN网关/智能网关接入的数据库
- **Agent**：通过备份网关接入的数据库
- **DDS**：云MongoDB
- **Other**：通过IP:Port直连的数据库
parameters.name: source_endpoint_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The region of the database. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html to query this value.

> This parameter is required when **SourceEndpointInstanceType** is RDS, ECS, DDS, Express, or Agent
parameters.help_zh:
数据库地域，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。

> **SourceEndpointInstanceType**为RDS、ECS、DDS、Express、Agent时，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_region

parameters.help_en:
The database instance ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html to query this value.

> This parameter is required when **SourceEndpoint**.**InstanceType** is **RDS**, **ECS**, **DDS**, or **Express**
parameters.help_zh:
数据库实例ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。

> **SourceEndpoint**.**InstanceType**为**RDS**、**ECS**、**DDS**、**Express**时，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The database endpoint. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html to query this value.

> This parameter is required when **SourceEndpointInstanceType** is **express**, **agent**, or **other**

parameters.name: source_endpoint_ip

parameters.help_en:

parameters.help_en:
The database name. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html to query this value.

v1_parameters.help_zh:
数据库所在位置，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。取值如下：

- **RDS**
- **ECS**
- **Express**：通过专线/VPN网关/智能网关接入的数据库
- **Agent**：通过备份网关接入的数据库
- **DDS**：云MongoDB
- **Other**：通过IP:Port直连的数据库
v1_parameters.name: SourceEndpointInstanceType

v1_parameters.help_en:
The Oracle SID name.

> This parameter is required when the database type is Oracle
v1_parameters.help_zh:
Oracle SID名称。

> 数据库类型为Oracle时，该参数必传
v1_parameters.name: SourceEndpointOracleSID

v1_parameters.help_en:
The password.

> This parameter is optional when the database type is **Redis**, or when the database location is **agent** and the database type is **SQL Server**. It is required in other scenarios
v1_parameters.help_zh:
密码。

> 数据库类型为**Redis**，或者数据库所在位置为**agent**且数据库类型为**SQL Server**时该参数非必须，其他场景均必传
v1_parameters.name: SourceEndpointPassword

v1_parameters.help_en:
The database port. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html to query this value.

> This parameter is required when **SourceEndpoint**.**InstanceType** is **express**, **agent**, **other**, or **ECS**
v1_parameters.help_zh:
数据库端口，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。

> **SourceEndpoint**.**InstanceType**为**express**、**agent**、**other**、**ECS**时，该参数必传
v1_parameters.name: SourceEndpointPort

v1_parameters.help_en:
The region of the database. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html to query this value.

> This parameter is required when **SourceEndpointInstanceType** is RDS, ECS, DDS, Express, or Agent
v1_parameters.help_zh:
数据库地域，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。

> **SourceEndpointInstanceType**为RDS、ECS、DDS、Express、Agent时，该参数必传
v1_parameters.name: SourceEndpointRegion

v1_parameters.help_en:
The database account.

> This parameter is optional when the database type is **Redis**, or when the database location is **agent** and the database type is **SQL Server**. It is required in other scenarios
v1_parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号。

> 数据库类型为**Redis**，或者数据库所在位置为**agent**且数据库类型为**SQL Server**时该参数非必须，其他场景均必传
v1_parameters.name: SourceEndpointUserName
